note: _suscepta est autem a populo tua sanitas quidem iustorum_ – thy people receives the salvation (_sanitas_) of the just (Douay Version). – Giuseppe Scarpat: “sanitas” come traduzione Latina di sôtêria (Sap 6,26; 18,7). In: Núria Carduch Benages – Jacques Vermeylen (eds.): _Treasures of Wisdom_. Leuven 1999 (xxvii, 463, 7 pp.), pp. 241–253.
